description: IT-05/S2: least-privilege reader of a tenant's stored reply locale (knowledge/confidential/<tenant>/locale.json). libs/core locale resolution assumes it, bound to the turn's tenant scope, so surface runtimes whose role cannot read the confidential tier still reply in the tenant locale; it grants that single file only and no write (persona worker). It is a tenant-bound reader (authority.ts TENANT_BOUND_READER_ROLES): the bound tenant must be explicit and equal the caller's active tenant when one exists.
